Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: BCP/DR evidence request for vendor assessment

Hi Karthik,

We're kicking off the vendor assessment for our platform integrations and have a quick set of asks regarding Business Continuity / Disaster Recovery. Could you please provide the following by EOD Monday (June 16):

- Per-service RTO and RPO (auth, model-serving, embeddings storage, control plane, telemetry) in a simple table (CSV is fine).
- Last DR exercise/dry-run report and executive summary (can be redacted).
- A short summary of backup cadence, replication method (sync/async), and cross-region failover approach.
- Any runbook excerpts that describe the automated failover steps and roll-back criteria.

Our SIG/CAIQ reviewers will map these to specific questions; if you can include the RTO/RPO in minutes/hours that helps. If SOC 2 reports or SOC 2-containment evidence are available under NDA, let us know the legal contact to request them.

Thanks — we appreciate a clear package so our InfoSec team can close this section.

Best,
Emily Stone
Senior Security Analyst
Greenline Health

[Attachment: vendor-assessment-questions.pdf]

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Emily Stone <emily.stone@greenlinehealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:15:00 -0700
Subject: RTO/RPO matrix and DR summary (initial)

Emily, Karthik — attaching the initial artifacts. See attached: rto_rpo-matrix-2025.csv and bcp-summary-2025-05.pdf (executive summary). The CSV has per-service rows and the PDF contains a one-page exec summary plus last dry-run high level metrics.

Key details (short):
- Auth service (token/identity): RTO = 30 minutes; RPO = 5 minutes. Auth sits on a primary DB with logical replication and high-frequency write-ahead-log shipping to secondary replicas.
- Model serving (inference tier): RTO = 1 hour; RPO = 15 minutes. Models are stored in S3 with cross-region replication; serving nodes are rebuilt from AMIs + cached weights.
- Embeddings store (vector DB): RTO = 2 hours; RPO = 1 hour. Embeddings are asynchronously replicated; typical replication lag is under 6 minutes but we size for 1 hour to account for heavy load scenarios.
- Control plane (orchestration/kv): RTO = 4 hours; RPO = near-zero for config (we persist config changes synchronously across control-plane replicas).
- Telemetry/metrics pipeline: RTO = 6 hours; RPO = best-effort (we retain raw telemetry in cold storage for 30 days).

Last DR exercise: 2025-04-18 (dry-run, cross-region failover). Highlights in dr-dryrun-report-202504.pdf:
- Planned failover of model-serving tier completed (full traffic cutover to secondary region) in 22 minutes measured from first failover step to healthy readiness check.
- Observed RPO during test: auth ~2 minutes; embeddings replication lag peaked ~6 minutes because we exercised a synthetic load to stress the pipeline.
- No data loss observed for production customer keys (redaction applied in attached report).

Backup cadence:
- Full backups daily for critical DBs; WAL shipping every 1 minute for primary relational stores.
- Snapshots of model artifact buckets every 12 hours; cross-region async replication.

Failover approach:
- Automated route update via traffic manager + DNS TTL reduction for fast cutover.
- Orchestration runbook triggers rebuild of serving autoscaling groups and warms caches via prewarming job.

Attachments: rto_rpo-matrix-2025.csv, bcp-summary-2025-05.pdf, dr-dryrun-report-202504.pdf

If you need deeper logs for the dry-run, we can provide an extended pack under NDA; otherwise the redacted PDF and the CSV should map to the SIG/CAIQ items.

—Priyom
Senior SRE, Reliability Engineering
Redwood Inference

[Attachment stubs included: rto_rpo-matrix-2025.csv (table), bcp-summary-2025-05.pdf (exec summary), dr-dryrun-report-202504.pdf (redacted dry-run report)]

From: Emily Stone <emily.stone@greenlinehealth.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RTO/RPO matrix and DR summary (initial)

Thanks Priyom — this is helpful and timely. A few clarifying asks from our InfoSec team before we close the SIG items:

1) Embeddings store: you list RPO = 1 hour but observed replication lag of 6 minutes during the test. Can you confirm whether the 1-hour figure is a conservative SLA or a hard service-level RPO? Our reviewers want the operational RPO used for risk modeling (i.e., the value you expect in production normal conditions).

2) For the dry-run report, could you include the specific runbook step that triggered the traffic cutover and the timestamped snapshot (redacted timestamps fine) showing the metric that signaled readiness in the secondary region? That helps our reviewers validate the failover detection criteria.

3) SOC 2: we prefer vendor SOC 2 Type II under NDA. Please loop in your legal team and provide a contact or link to request the report.

If you can provide the runbook excerpt and a short confirmation on point (1) by EOD Monday, we can mark the BCP/DR section as closed.

Thanks — Emily

Hi Emily — quick follow-up with the clarifications you requested.

1) Embeddings RPO: the 1-hour figure in the CSV is a conservative operational SLA intended to cover extreme load/repair windows. The typical production RPO we observe in steady-state is under 10 minutes (we recorded ~6 minutes during the April dry-run). For your risk modeling, use 10 minutes as an operational expectation; we keep the 1-hour SLA as a worst-case commitment for high-load recovery scenarios.

2) Runbook excerpt and signal: attached is a one-page runbook excerpt (also available on Confluence) that shows the automatic health-check threshold that triggers traffic promotion (>=95% successful readiness probes across the target ASG for 60s). The dry-run report contains the timestamped readiness check that we redacted; the attached dr-dryrun-report-202504.pdf includes the redacted snapshot you asked for.

3) SOC 2 access: Laura on copy will coordinate the NDA / SOC 2 request. Laura — can you share the standard SOC 2 request path and legal contact?

Attachments included here: dr-dryrun-report-202504.pdf, rto_rpo-matrix-2025.csv, runbook-failover-link.txt
